rationale: v3.2 enforced only the four OID fields and a safety check on artifacts, silently accepting envelopes that omitted schema/lab/batch/leaf/lease/external-branch-binding/literal-tests/build-provenance and that never verified artifact hashes, sizes or the exact artifact set, nor R non-emptiness. v3.3 keeps the C->R->E two-commit model (R = implementation result with parent C; E = envelope container with parent R; remote branch -> E; ONLY R is integration-eligible) and adds strict runtime enforcement of every normative field.

top_level_keys.policy: all required keys present; unknown top-level keys rejected; forbidden self-binding keys rejected; no optional/ambiguous fields are permitted unless enumerated here

validation_rules: C, R, E resolvable as commits
R has exactly one parent and R^ == C
E has exactly one parent and E^ == R
R != C
git diff --quiet C R returns nonzero (C..R non-empty)
envelope ABSENT from C and R; PRESENT in E
diff C..R non-empty and owned-only
diff R..E exactly the single frozen envelope path
schema EXACT == headless-lab-result-envelope/v3.3
lab EXACT == batch-manifest lab for the requested lab
batch_id EXACT == batch-manifest batch_id
leaf_id EXACT == batch-manifest leaf_id
lease_id EXACT == batch-manifest lease_id
git_object_format EXACT == repo object format
candidate_commit_oid == C; implementation_result_commit_oid == R; implementation_result_tree_oid == R^{tree}
external_branch_binding.remote == origin and planned_branch EXACT
required top-level keys present; unknown keys rejected; forbidden self-binding/controller-future keys rejected
leaf_literal_tests: EXACT set of test IDs == authoritative batch-manifest test IDs
leaf_literal_tests[].command_sha256 == sha256(UTF-8 bytes of the frozen authoritative command)
leaf_literal_tests[].exit_code == 0
leaf_literal_tests[].started_at_utc/ended_at_utc parseable and started <= ended
artifacts: EXACT set == set of tracked files modified or added in C..R (owned paths only)
artifacts: each path present in R; sha256 == blob sha256; size == blob size; kind in allowed set
artifacts may NOT contain the envelope, E-only files, untracked/ignored binaries, unchanged paths, or out-of-ownership paths
artifacts NEVER empty for a valid result (R non-empty enforced)
leaf_build_claim: present and structurally valid per lab (LAB-A: not_applicable with null compiler fields; LAB-B: claimed_built with sources/commands/outputs)
no controller-future claims inside E (leaf envelope declares leaf facts only; controller acceptance is a SEPARATE receipt created after E is pushed)
naming_rule: Git object IDs use *_commit_oid / *_tree_oid / git_object_format; the term 'SHA-256' is never used for Git object IDs. Ordinary file hashes keep the suffix '_sha256'.

separation_of_evidence.leaf_envelope_E: binds C/R; leaf test claims; leaf build claim; tracked artifact manifest
separation_of_evidence.controller_acceptance_receipt_A: created AFTER E is pushed; binds remote branch -> E; independently reruns literal tests on clean R; runs acceptance harness on clean R; independently verifies artifacts; performs controlled rebuild; records final completion verdict
separation_of_evidence.rule: A is NEVER included inside E
